title: camt.053 Reconciliation Workbench
description: Imports a camt.053 statement (strict schema-subset parse) plus a counterpart expectation set (CSV via the hand-rolled workbook core), runs a deterministic EndToEndId-then-tolerance match engine, and produces a hash-chained reconciliation receipt with per-disposition exception receipts.

date_tolerance_days.description: Date tolerance in days for the amount/date secondary match rule

reconciliation_receipt.description: statement_digest, expectation_set_digest, match_rule_declaration, matched/unmatched counts, exception_digests, execution_hash

mcp_tool_definition.name: camt053_reconcile
mcp_tool_definition.description: Matches a camt.053 statement against a counterpart expectation set (EndToEndId exact match, then amount/date tolerance), returning a hash-chained reconciliation receipt and an exceptions list. Prepare/hash/receipt only, not a transmitted settlement.
